It might be worth some further discussion whether to use `size_t`.

We haven't tended to use it historically in containers - it seems like one of those vague flaky C types (like `long` etc) but most programmers these days have moved to fixed width types simply because vague types are a potential nightmare for multiplatform / compiler.
